examples.name: Create a partner webhook
examples.description: Sends events for every merchant under your partner to the endpoint. Call it with a partner key.

examples.name: Create a merchant webhook
examples.description: Sends events for one merchant only. Call it with that merchant's key. The mutation has no merchant argument.

examples.name: Get a webhook
examples.description: Filters by `endpoint`. Omit `endpoint` to list every webhook your API key owns.

examples.name: List a merchant's webhooks
examples.description: A merchant key sees only the webhooks created with that merchant's key.

examples.name: Pause a webhook
examples.description: Stops deliveries to the endpoint. Pending retries are dropped and are not sent when you turn it back on.

examples.name: Rename a webhook
examples.description: Changes only the name. The endpoint URL can't be changed.

examples.name: Delete a webhook
examples.description: Removes the endpoint. Delivery history for it stays queryable until it expires.

examples.name: List delivery attempts for an endpoint
examples.description: Returns attempts newest first. Pass `last_evaluated_key` from the response to get the next page.

examples.name: Get every attempt for one event
examples.description: Filters by the `event_id` from the webhook body. Returns the first attempt and every retry, newest first.

examples.name: Get webhook verification keys
examples.description: Returns the Ed25519 public key that signs your webhooks. Partner and merchant keys get the same key.
